criteria.support_condition: Comparable operating records show no improvement in unit costs or margins as activity expands, substantial operating losses relative to revenue, and material uncertainty about financing ordinary operations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish meaningful scale-related cost improvements, an absence of substantial operating losses, or secure funding and durable operating cash generation. Evidence resolving only one component does not settle the entire statement.
